verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a managed live-streaming service, and in-product AI-generated insights over stream or audience data is a plausible capability for such a platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers streaming, SDKs, EventBridge monitoring, timed-metadata polling and an AWS docs llms.txt. None of it describes AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
